Steps: Log in on the office-PC agent with a valid website email + password
Expected result: Login succeeds; device appears under the user's devices on the website

Test case: Wrong password is refused and throttled
Steps: Enter a wrong password 6+ times
Expected result: Each attempt refused; after the limit further attempts are blocked for a while (429)

Test case: Bind a Tally company to a workspace
Steps: Open a company in Tally; pick the workspace in the agent
Expected result: Workspace shows sync state 'first sync'; company name/GUID stored

Test case: Second PC takes over the same company
Steps: Bind the same company from a second PC
Expected result: Asked to confirm take-over; after confirming the first PC stops syncing

Test case: Wrong company opened on the PC
Steps: After binding company A open company B in Tally and let the agent sync
Expected result: Uploads refused (company mismatch); nothing of B mixed into A's workspace

Steps: Bind a company and let the first sync run
Expected result: State becomes 'ready'; current + previous FY marked complete

Steps: Compare cloud voucher count per month with Tally Day Book count per month
Expected result: Counts equal for every month

Steps: After first sync check the website sync status
Expected result: Last parity = OK; no mismatching ledgers

Steps: Company with a USD customer: run first sync + parity
Expected result: USD ledger shows 'match_revalued'; unrealised difference equals Tally's 'Unadjusted Forex Gain/Loss' row

Steps: Let the agent backfill an older FY
Expected result: Oldest complete FY moves back; 'last synced' time does not change

Steps: Create a new sales voucher in Tally; wait one sync cycle
Expected result: Voucher appears in cloud with correct date/amount/ledgers

Steps: Change the amount of a voucher from a previous month/year
Expected result: Cloud copy shows the new amount; parity still OK

Steps: Rename a ledger that has vouchers
Expected result: Old vouchers show the new name; no false parity alarm

Steps: Delete a voucher in Tally
Expected result: After reconcile the voucher is marked deleted in cloud; ledger balances drop accordingly

Steps: Cancel a voucher in Tally
Expected result: Excluded from totals; parity OK

Steps: Create an optional voucher and a post-dated voucher
Expected result: Optional excluded from balances; post-dated counted only from its date; parity OK

Steps: Create a new ledger and immediately a voucher using it
Expected result: Both synced; no 'missing master' error

Steps: Make a day of normal entries; let the daily check run
Expected result: Parity OK

Test case: Typing in Tally during a check
Steps: Keep entering vouchers while a parity check runs
Expected result: Check is discarded (Tally was moving) and retried later; no false alarm

Steps: Simulate a missed voucher (e.g. block one upload)
Expected result: Mismatch detected with a cause; agent re-fetches; next check OK

Steps: Take a backup; make entries; restore the backup in Tally
Expected result: Website shows 'restore detected' + offers resync; after confirming cloud equals the restored Tally

Steps: Replace/relink the company data folder
Expected result: Relink prompt on website; needs password to confirm; then resync

Steps: Close Tally while a sync is running
Expected result: Agent waits and resumes when Tally reopens; no duplicate vouchers

Steps: Disconnect network during a sync; reconnect
Expected result: Upload retried; each batch stored once (no duplicates)

Steps: Restart the server during a sync
Expected result: Sync resumes; website state unchanged after restart

Steps: Run a sync on 31 March evening and 1 April (IST)
Expected result: New FY starts on 1 April IST; previous FY moves to 'previous'

Steps: Log in as user B; try to open user A's workspace sync status
Expected result: Refused (403/404); A's data unchanged

Steps: Revoke the office PC from the website
Expected result: Agent stops syncing and must log in again

Steps: Delete a workspace on the website
Expected result: Agent refused immediately; synced data purged after 30 days (or at once with purge --now)

Steps: Check server logs after a sync
Expected result: Only counts/codes; no amounts or party names

Steps: Lower the alert limit (V2_STORAGE_ALERT_BYTES) and sync a company
Expected result: Storage alert shown for the company; sync continues

Steps: Check vouchers older than the previous FY
Expected result: Only current + previous FY keep the raw Tally copy; older have columns only

Steps: Sync a company with security or TallyVault on
Expected result: Works once the company is open; while a login prompt is open it is treated as 'company not open'

Steps: Run the full flow on a real Windows PC (not Wine) with a licensed TallyPrime
Expected result: All P1 cases above pass

Steps: Sync a company with several years and many vouchers
Expected result: First sync completes; parity OK; website stays responsive
